answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that grows with its reputation, like quartz forming slowly under pressure: cheap copies cannot afford the bond, and slashing burns the stake if the same operator is caught running clones. A single honest agent earns a lasting ember of trust from completed work, while Sybil copies start cold and must pay the full cost again. Peer attestations then echo only verified history, so creating thousands of fake identities costs more than the rewards they could harvest.
